definitions: To stop making an effort because one is satisfied with past achievements.
To rely on past successes and not strive for new ones.
To be content with previous accomplishments and cease further work or progress.
examples: After winning the championship, the team couldn't afford resting on laurels.
He was warned not to start resting on laurels if he wanted to stay competitive.
Many companies fail by resting on laurels instead of innovating.
